o1: Enables protein homodimerization activity and superoxide dismutase activity. Involved in removal of superoxide radicals and defense response to bacterium. Is located in mitochondrial respirasome. Is expressed in egg-laying apparatus; head; intestine; pharynx; and tail. Used to study enterotoxigenic Escherichia coli infection. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in artery disease (multiple); autoimmune disease (multiple); cardiomyopathy (multiple); liver disease (multiple); and optic nerve disease (multiple). Orthologous to human SOD2 (superoxide dismutase 2).
